thread:
Liu: Noticing spike in mTLS failures in eu-central after yesterday's key-policy change. Errors show `AccessDenied` on kms:Decrypt for node-role used by cert-agent.
Priya: can you paste a log line?
Liu: `2026-04-05T08:14:02Z cert-agent: unwrap failed: AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:eu-central-1:...:rotator-key` then downstream `tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad certificate`
cert-bot: CloudTrail: 4 denies between 08:13:50 and 08:15:01 UTC for principal arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/node-cert-role/i-0ff12abc
Priya: likely key policy omitted the instance role after scoping. Short-term: re-add role to key policy for eu-central and restart cert-agent pods.
Liu: Agree. Also request we enable `sts:TagSession` on assume-role calls so CloudTrail shows pod metadata. Without that it's tedious to map denies to pods.
infra-oncall: I can apply the policy patch in a controlled window. Will snapshot current key policy first: `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/rotator-key --policy-name default > /tmp/policy.json` and upload to s3.
Priya: add check: run `kubectl get certificates -A | grep Pending` after restart and validate no OCSP errors.
Liu: follow-ups: 1) canonicalize KMS principal mappings in infra repo 2) add CI lint to block key-policy PRs without footprint check 3) roll out session-tagging and library changes to cert-agent.
infra-oncall: policy patched and cert-agent restarted at 08:27:12 UTC. Monitoring shows unwraps succeeding. Leaving incident notes in the ticket.
Liu: thanks. We'll track the longer-term fixes in SEC-800.
